identity.origin: Slag-Gate Basalt Causeway, The Crucible Reaches

identity.origin: Abyssal Trench of the Leviathan, The Shattered Archipelago & Abyssal Shelf
identity.physical_appearance: Defender clad in iridescent mother-of-pearl armor holding a scalloped pavise — a nimble, quick-deploying coral warden (Curved shell-like defensive silhouette) clad in iridescent mother-of-pearl and living reef-coral, exhibiting interlocking defensive barrier aura and planted shield stance and translucent hexagonal prismatic spell-ward halo.
identity.personality_or_disposition: Grimly resolute, carrying the memory of fallen predecessors. Operates as a bulwark (1 Attack / 5 Health) affiliated with the Pelagic Navigators of the Wake at Abyssal Trench of the Leviathan.
identity.history: Nacreous shells grown over a century deflect both steel and errant hexes. First recorded during the Night of Clapperless Bells (Year 339 AC) when Harpoon-Master Corvus mobilized the Pelagic Navigators of the Wake at Abyssal Trench of the Leviathan.
identity.important_relationships: Serves alongside Harpoon-Master Corvus (Vanguard of the Coral Spire) at Abyssal Trench of the Leviathan and coordinates three-lane maneuvers with Abyssal Navigator Kaelo.
identity.world_abilities: Channels Tidebound resonance (current) to manifest: Guard, Ward. Current: When an allied creature moves into this lane, restore 2 Health to this unit.
identity.narrative_importance: Dependable coral warden forming the field backbone of the Pelagic Navigators of the Wake across Abyssal Trench of the Leviathan.
identity.flavor_text: Nacreous shells grown over a century deflect both steel and errant hexes.
identity.collection_biography: During the Night of Clapperless Bells, the Pelagic Navigators of the Wake relied on specialists capable of holding Abyssal Trench of the Leviathan against overwhelming odds. Pearlguard Protector emerged from that crucible: Nacreous shells grown over a century deflect both steel and errant hexes. Today, duelists studying under Harpoon-Master Corvus prize its 2-Aether tempo and guard, ward.

identity.physical_appearance: Monumental bone-crowned arch-medium seated on a walking throne of fossilized leviathan ribs — a towering, high-Aether primordial lich (Towering ossuary sovereign surrounded by rising spirit lanterns) clad in verdigris swamp-iron and fossilized bone, exhibiting interlocking defensive barrier aura and planted shield stance and emerging spectral phoenix-seed or lingering Echo core and siphoning ribbons of vital crimson-emerald energy.
identity.personality_or_disposition: Wary of outsiders but unshakably loyal to lane-mates. Operates as a colossus (7 Attack / 8 Health) affiliated with the Order of the Peat-Fog Lantern at Lantern-Walk of the Unforgotten.
identity.history: First Keeper of the Forgotten Names; no Echo truly perishes while Odrin’s great censer burns in the catacombs. First recorded during the Founding of the Lumenport Tag Charter (Year 510 AC) when Elegy-Singer Mara mobilized the Order of the Peat-Fog Lantern at Lantern-Walk of the Unforgotten.
identity.important_relationships: Serves alongside Elegy-Singer Mara (Chanter of the Briar-Cairns) at Lantern-Walk of the Unforgotten and coordinates three-lane maneuvers with Blight-Alchemist Fenwick.
identity.world_abilities: Channels Gravewild resonance (reclaim) to manifest: Guard, Rebirth, Drain. On Summon: Reclaim 2 cards from your discard pile and inflict 1 Corrode counter (-1/-1) on all enemy creatures.
identity.narrative_importance: Renowned specialist of the Order of the Peat-Fog Lantern sought after by veteran tournament duelists in Lumenport.
identity.flavor_text: First Keeper of the Forgotten Names; no Echo truly perishes while Odrin’s great censer burns in the catacombs.
identity.collection_biography: Chronicles of the Founding of the Lumenport Tag Charter recount how Elegy-Singer Mara and Blight-Alchemist Fenwick first encountered Odrin, Arch-Reclaimer of the First Age guarding the approaches to Lantern-Walk of the Unforgotten. First Keeper of the Forgotten Names; no Echo truly perishes while Odrin’s great censer burns in the catacombs. Now a mainstay of the Order of the Peat-Fog Lantern, this 8-Aether colossus rewards disciplined resource timing.
